name: registerToolDefs
description: Register full tool definitions into the process-global PromptHolderRegistry so tools whose definition is NOT in the C++ ToolCatalog (static-JS, MCP) can ship as `{ ref }` and the host fills the schema. Overwrite-by-name; nexus_web calls it once per session for stable defs (and again when an MCP server reconnects).

inputs.name: defs
inputs.description: Full tool definition objects: { type:'function', name, description?, parameters, strict?, inputExamples? }.
